sloka: इति नः पुरुषव्याघ्रः सदा रामोऽभिभाषते ।व्यसनेषु मनुष्याणां भृशं भवति दुःखितः ॥२-२-४०॥
transliteration: iti naḥ puruṣavyāghraḥ sadā rāmo'bhibhāṣate ।vyasaneṣu manuṣyāṇāṁ bhṛśaṁ bhavati duḥkhitaḥ ॥2-2-40॥

translations.english: He grieves profoundly whenever people are afflicted by misfortunes (and) rejoices like a father on festive occasions.
